mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_demand_extend_apply ( demand_id, stage_id, creator_id, days, hours, reason, status, apply_type, applied_at, decided_at, decided_by, due_after, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{demandId}, #{stageId}, #{creatorId}, #{days}, #{hours}, #{reason}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'pending'), COALESCE(#{applyType}, 'request'), NOW(), CASE WHEN COALESCE(#{status}, 'pending') = 'pending' THEN NULL ELSE NOW() END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(#{status}, 'pending') = 'pending' THEN NULL ELSE #{decidedBy} END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(#{status}, 'pending') = 'pending' THEN NULL ELSE #{dueAfter} END, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_demand_extend_apply WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY applied_at DESC, apply_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.*, s.stage_order FROM sys_demand_extend_apply a LEFT JOIN sys_demand_stage s ON s.stage_id = a.stage_id WHERE a.status = 'pending' AND a.apply_type = 'request' AND a.applied_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ORDER BY a.apply_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_demand_extend_apply SET status = #{status}, decided_at = NOW(), decided_by = #{decidedBy}, due_after = #{dueAfter}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE apply_id = #{applyId} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, s.stage_order FROM sys_demand_extend_apply a LEFT JOIN sys_demand_stage s ON s.stage_id = a.stage_id WHERE a.stage_id = #{stageId} ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC, a.apply_id DESC
SELECT a.*, s.stage_order FROM sys_demand_extend_apply a LEFT JOIN sys_demand_stage s ON s.stage_id = a.stage_id WHERE a.demand_id = #{demandId} ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC, a.apply_id DESC
